title: WAMTA home page data (home.yml)
description: Drives the per-year landing page rendered by _includes/index.md. Required keys must always be present; optional keys toggle sidebar cards or surface previous-year links.

lead.description: Short opening paragraph rendered with the .lead class. Markdown allowed.

overview.description: Long-form workshop overview paragraph (motivation, context). Markdown allowed.

topics.description: Bulleted list of topics of interest, rendered as a tight markdown list.

artifacts.description: Optional one-line markdown blurb pointing to the year's artifact collection (Zenodo etc.). Empty string disables the section.

previous_events.description: Optional list of past WAMTA workshops shown under 'Previous events:'. An empty array suppresses the section header.

url.description: Link to the past event's site.

artifacts_url.description: Optional link to that year's artifact collection.

show_contact.description: When true, renders the contact-us include below the home content.

show_important_dates.description: When true, renders the Important Dates sidebar card on the home page.

show_news.description: When true, renders the News sidebar card on the home page.

show_sponsors.description: When true, renders the Sponsors sidebar card on the home page.
